description: Server-side identify posted to heapanalytics.com/api/v1/identify. Heap requires app_id, the SDK user_id, and identity. Track stays vendor/heap-track. Add user properties is vendor/heap-user-properties.

params.name: app_id
params.description: It is the Heap environment ID. Heap documents it as required on identify.
params.fix_hint: Set app_id to the environment ID from Heap Projects.

params.name: user_id
params.description: It is the anonymous user_id from the Heap SDK. Heap documents a numeric string between 0 and 2^53-1.
params.fix_hint: Send the Heap SDK user_id as digits, not the login email.

params.name: identity
params.description: It is the known identity, such as an email. Heap documents it as required and case-sensitive, limited to 255 characters.
params.fix_hint: Send a unique identity. Heap drops a second identity on the same user_id.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. The source does not mandate a timezone.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as 2017-03-10T22:21:56+00:00.

params.description: The vendor documents `` in the request contract.
